title: GFCC Consensus Port v1
description: Deliberation for 格契. Success is threshold AND bidirectional human acknowledge. Score without evidence is invalid. AI may contribute observation to score_evidence; parties who ack must be human. Having a scored result is not success.

threshold.name: CONSENSUS_THRESHOLD
threshold.notes: Scoring formula is circle-defined (e.g. reputation × contribution). This contract requires evidence traceability, not a hardcoded algorithm.

items.description: Human Principal.sub. AI is not a party.

score_evidence.description: Required before status can leave proposed. Empty evidence ⇒ score is invalid.

basis.description: Why this score. May cite memory / contribution / ai observation ids.

score.notes: Must attach score_evidence. AI observation may appear as one evidence item. Parties remain human.

acknowledge.notes: Each human party must ack. AI cannot ack. Partial ack stays awaiting_ack.

invariants: score without score_evidence is invalid; cannot leave proposed
score >= threshold → consensus_passed, then awaiting_ack; still can_complete = false
all human parties acked → consensus_verified; only then can_complete = true
expired or failed never promote to verified
Ask result with matches/candidates must include consensus_status; UI must not treat list-as-success
AI evidence is auxiliary; AI never replaces a party ack
